title: Pure SWAP-007 Newton quotient representability oracle
protocol: PIN_PATCH_AND_B1_11 -> IMPLEMENT_PURE_GUARD -> EXACT_BRANCH_ORACLE -> EXTREME_CASES -> O0_O2_REPLAY -> HOLD_SOLVER_BINDING

source.guard: abs(fi_a) > max(tiny(1.0d0), abs(fi)/huge(1.0d0)); else set lnew=huge(1.0d0)
source.restart: existing lnew>1.d3 or counterMacroSub>100 branch resets lnew_initial and the sub-counter

scope: pure representability decision and source-ordered lnew expression/sentinel
pure boolean for the existing restart condition
non_goals: MACRO/SOLVE/MICRO runtime integration, iteration mutation or solver policy change
changing Newton formula, thresholds, restart seed progression or iteration ceiling
Bartholomeus cache/c_top ownership or lifecycle qualification
pass_conditions: 100,000 deterministic finite inputs match the B1.11 guard and restart predicate bitwise/boolean
unrepresentable quotient and zero/tiny derivative select huge sentinel and existing restart
representable near-limit quotient preserves the source update
non-finite inputs fail closed without changing solver state
